boundary_evidence: contiguous linker run: 0x02067f68..0x0206879c, 13 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt (each entry's end is the next entry's start, all marked `complete`).

SOURCE ORDER: mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order. Read from the top down, the run is the parent-side function order of NitroSDK's mb_gameinfo.c (ntrtwl's copy; Pokemon D/P's agrees): MBi_MakeGameInfo, MBi_ReadIconInfo, MB_UpdateGameInfoMember, mystrlen, MB_AddGameInfo, MB_InitSendGameInfoStatus, MBi_ClearSendStatus, MB_SendGameInfoBeacon, MBi_ReadyBeaconSendStatus, MBi_InitSendFixedBeacon, MBi_SendFixedBeacon, MBi_InitSendVolatBeacon, MBi_SendVolatBeacon, every function in its place. Lego Star Wars II's symbols.txt has the same thirteen names in the same order at 0x020daa6c..0x020db2a8. MB_DeleteGameInfo and the child's beacon-receive functions are absent from both ROMs: nothing calls them, so they were dead-stripped.

DATA: the beacon send status (data_020a9d2c, the SDK's mbss) and the beacon buffer (data_020a9d40, bsendBuff; data_020a9d48, data_020a9d4e and data_020a9d50 are its checksum span, fixed piece and volatile members) are used by the functions in this run and by no other code in the tree.

BOTTOM EDGE: MBi_BlockHeaderEnd (0x02067f2c..0x02067f68) is mb_common.c's (arm9/MB_Common, src/engine/mb/MB_Common.c): it flushes the send buffer from the data cache and hands it to MBi_SendMP. It is not game-record code.
TOP EDGE: MBi_CheckWmErrcode (0x0206879c) opens the SDK's mb_wm_base.c (arm9/MB_WmBase).
notes: All thirteen members carry the SDK name on a statement-for-statement match with ntrtwl's NitroSDK mb_gameinfo.c, allowing for this older SDK's differences. The record has no userVolatData and there is no send-volat callback. MB_SendGameInfoBeacon takes no ggid, tgid or attribute; MBi_SendFixedBeacon and MBi_SendVolatBeacon fetch them themselves and set the beacon with attribute | 2 where ntrtwl's has | 3 (the ENTRY flag, NitroSDK Rev 1.41). MBi_ReadyBeaconSendStatus (formerly func_02068398) is the body as it was before Rev 1.42 (11/18/2005), which added the empty-list WM_SetGameInfo.
The SDK built this file as C, and so does this TU. The record, send status and beacon types are declared in this file only.
